body.h: Ben does a sweep feed on two count. He passes to the middle, his left, the middle, and then his right. He also passes twice to each juggler in turn: twice to Anne, then twice to Clare, then twice to Daniel. Anne, Clare and Daniel do a countdown from two count to four count: two count, three count, four count, three count. They also walk on a figure of eight pattern as they do this. They pass twice to Ben on two count, as they walk forward through the middle of the figure of eight. They then walk to the edge of the figure of eight, turn to face the middle of the pattern and throw a left hand pass to one of the other walkers at the back of the figure of eight. They then walk to the back of the figure of eight pattern and throw another left hand pass to another walker. Then the pattern repeats on the other side of the figure of eight.
